en: Choose one official stargazing site, inspect its return path before twilight and finish before transport or parking restrictions become uncertain. Arrive while signs, edges and the walking surface remain visible. Mark the vehicle, the safe observation footprint and the simplest retreat before opening equipment. A useful session can be short.
